_comment: Canonical tag list. add_circuit.py rejects tags not in this list. Open a PR to add new tags.

tags.beginner: Suitable for people new to quantum computing
tags.intermediate: Requires understanding of basic quantum gates
tags.fundamental: A foundational circuit every quantum practitioner should know
tags.entanglement: Creates or manipulates entangled quantum states
tags.bell: Bell state or Bell basis related circuit
tags.rotation: Uses parametric rotation gates (Rx, Ry, Rz)
tags.education: Built primarily for learning and demonstration
